{{Quote|I knew a smuggler who'd memorized the Hundred Prescriptions of Alsidas when he was a kid taking religious training, and he could still rattle them off thirty years later.|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="Before the Storm">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Hundred Prescriptions of Alsidas''''' was a religious text that was reputed for its length. The [[Socorro/Legends|Socorran]] businessman [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] knew a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who had memorized that text ''verbatim'' when he was a [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]].
